nodes.text: Pot's warm, waker. What do you need?

choices.text: What else can a fire do?

nodes.text: Anything you can catch or pull from the water, a fire will improve — chicken, beef, the brook's fish once you've the patience for the rod. Build your own fire out in the wild when you learn the knack, but any village hearth serves a traveller. Mine most of all.
Along the brook's near bank, south of the bridge — bushes, fibre, sageroot. Take a full pocket; the bank never begrudges it.
For you? Once. {item:cooked_chicken} — mind, it's hot. After this you cook your own; that's how kindness works when it's doing its job.
Warm hands, full pack, dry boots. Two out of three and you'll live.
